title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 507  An Act Converting the Gen. Tinio Provincial High School in the Municipality of Gen. Tinio, Province of Nueva Ecija, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Gen. Tinio National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

text.en:
The Gen. Tinio Provincial High School in the Municipality of Gen. Tinio, Province of Nueva
Ecija, is converted into a national high school to be known as the Gen. Tinio National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
